3490-5223-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5223-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

539-2060-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
539-2060-4687.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2841-7892-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7892-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2757-3525-7937.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Badgey.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

1512-2757-4222.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4506-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4506-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4091-5986-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
4091-5986-7791.description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Whisperer of the Wilds.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Whisperer of the Wilds.
Repeat.

4785-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4785-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4785-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

7296-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
7296-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
7296-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3192-5256-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

339-677-5147-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-4068-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1719-4068-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4050-4336-4763--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {R}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1017-3532-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1017-3532-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2438-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

851-2034-2267-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
851-2034-2267-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

856-2173-2438-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-2438-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-2438-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

38-2173-3025-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-6873.description:
Activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {5}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating three 2/2 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Soldiers, adding six {C}.
Repeat
1270-2034-6873.notes: You can skip step 2 during an iteration if you have {5} or more in your mana pool.

700-2836-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
700-2836-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
700-2836-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing you to draw 100 cards and win the game when you would draw from an empty library due to Laboratory Maniac.

2105-2921-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-2921-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2438-2523-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2438-2523-5560.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

914-2556-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2556-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Mnemonic Wall.
When Dockside Extortionist and Mnemonic Wall enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-2556-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1479-2907-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2057-2852.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by exiling the top two cards of your library due to Ashiok, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat.

2034-3263-3498-3613.description:
Cast Baithook Angler from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Hook-Haunt Drifter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hook-Haunt Drifter, adding {2}.
Because Dress Down causes Hook-Haunt Drifter to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Baithook Angler.
Repeat.

539-1339-1778-2232-3848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-1339-1778-2232-3848.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Omnath's second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity

1888-3542-3546.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce {3}{B}{G}.
1888-3542-3546.description:
Activate High Market by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, gaining you 1 life.
Activate Atzal's second ability by paying {3}{B}{G} and tapping it, returning Palinchron to the battlefield.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping Atzal, High Market, and five other lands that can produce {3}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

3350-3591-4591.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
